An empty template yields no parts.

Parsing failures throw `UriTemplateError` whose `index` is the position of the `{` that opens the offending expression, or of the stray character: `unterminated expression at 1`, `unexpected '}' at 1`, `empty expression at 0`, `empty variable specification at 0`, `reserved operator '=' at 0` for the operators `= , ! @ |`, `invalid variable name 'a-b' at 0`, and `invalid prefix modifier ':0' at 0`. Literal parts keep unreserved characters, the reserved characters `:/?#[]@!$&'()*+,;=` and existing percent-triplets, and percent-encode everything else as uppercase UTF-8 triplets. Each expression looks its variables up as own properties of `variables`; a name that is absent, `null`, `undefined`, an array with no usable members or an object with no usable members contributes nothing, and `null` or `undefined` members inside an array or object are skipped.
